notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements 0.3.7.4
notes.content:
Hello everybody, I know it's been a long time since the last update. This patch is bringing some long overdue bug fixes while I continue to polish a substantial overhaul of the rendering systems to finish up multi-layered map support; work that has been moving slowly forward this summer, though development had been suspended for nearly two years as life has restricted the time and energy I have to devote to development side-projects.

[list]
[*] Fixed glitchy behaviors of Steam Overlay/Toasts on monitors faster than 60hz
[*] Improved the handling of Draw/Move previews in a game where one or more players is present with high ping
[*] Fixed a crash when scrolling the mousewheel over non-dice text/empty-space in a dice roll text box
[*] Fixed a crash and improved steam API reconnect functionality.
[*] Fixed excessive memory use in excessively large dicerolls
[*] Fixed some issues in campaign creation with invalid file-path characters in the name.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented campaign switching in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.7.1 Added "Report a Problem" feature, Minor Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
As always, if you'd like to follow along with development you can [url=https://discord.com/invite/2kaQdX5zAb]join us on Discord![/url]

This patch has been worked on in parallel with the Multi-Layer feature, which is taking longer than I hoped to get developed due to a lot of life changes (all of them are good) that have all hit in the last month for me.

The main feature is the new "Report a Problem" button in the top right of player and DM clients. This makes it much easier to let me know if there's a problem without joining discord or hunting me down on Steam. So if there's a bug that's stuck in your craw, let me know!

Here's the full patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added the "Report a Problem" button and menu, reports are anonymously (unless you provide contact info) submitted via webhook to discord, no account required though.
[*] Modified double-click on a token so that it toggles "Active" and "Visible" together, except during a play session where "Active" will always be set true while "Visible" still toggles. Please do give me feedback on this change!
[*] Expanded the range of the Token Size Slider to go from 1/8th size all the way up to 10x
[*] Fixed an issue where quick-rolls saved to tokens were not being shown in the dice tray for the GM.
[*] Fixed an issue where GM dice rolls were being sent to your discord webhook if one is configured; GM rolls should now be private.
[*] Fixed a bug where the grid wizard was snapping to the current grid-state while you're trying to set the correct grid-size.
[*] Fixed a bug where invisible players still had a public movement path being draw.
[*] Fixed some goofy UI stuff on Player token selection for the GM, now you can set players visible/invisible when you have the selected.
[*] Fixed an annoyance where tokens don't remember their initiative roll if they get disabled and re-enabled during an encounter.
[*] Added some helpful error messages before crashing when Windows reports a program file has been corrupted or infected with a virus. 
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.7.0 Added Multi-Floor Support for maps
notes.content:
To follow along with the development, report a problem, or just say 'hi', [url=https://discord.com/invite/2kaQdX5zAb]Join us in Discord![/url]

This update, adds a Floor/Layer Management system so that each map can have multiple layers,rather than a separate map for every floor. While this update is relatively low impact, it lays the groundwork for the "Multi-Layer" rendering features which will be the next feature on the task list.

Map Layer Features:
[list]
[*] Added an "Add/Edit Floors" button to open the floor manager screen.
[*] Floor manager allows you to add layers above and below the primary map, and reorganize or delete them. Moving floors up and down automatically renames them if you leave the automatic floor name as part of the final name.
[*] Added a floor selector panel to the bottom right of the map display area. Mousing over a floor name pops up a preview of the floor.
[*] Added a "Use Main Map's Grid" checkbox on each floor in map-editor, letting you copy the grid from the main-floor, or customize your grid for the selected floor.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Updated Open-Image dialog filters to include *.Webp files by default.
[*] Fixed a number of issues with the Grid-Fill drawing tool. These weren't properly sent to anyone but the drawer, and would disappear after 10sec.
[*] Fixed a bug when undo-ing a Fill-Tool operation, where the DM undoing a "fill with fog" would end up erasing all of the fog for players (but working correctly on the DM)
[*] Improved the network code for sending maps, such that map images are automatically sent to lan clients, while only sent upon request to internet clients if a Steam-Cloud download fails.
[*] Simplified Player Steam API behaviors. Some clients would see Steam running with a full CPU core while playing "Dudes on a Map", along with problems with Steam friends locking up, and other oddities. This Steam issue seemed to be resolved in the Steam Beta Branch, but should also be resolved by this minimizing checking for API updates from Steam.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.6.3 Added "Launch Player Window" button and fixed minor/rare issue fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a "Launch Player Window" button next to the DM's ready checkbox - this will join the game you are in with the player client.
[*] Potentially fixed a rare rendering issue where some clients are unable to render the map, tokens, etc, and just show an empty background, and only drawing map on window-resize. [Updated 3rd party packages]
[*] Fixed a crash when switching campaigns
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.6.1 Small Fixes - Map Delete Crash And Big Token Move improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when deleting maps after opening the campaign switch menu.
[*] Fixed a bug with large-sized tokens where the token was in the wrong spot if you didn't grab it by the top-left corner.
[*] Fixed a bug where token de-select was higher priority than token-move-cancel, which caused some odd behaviors when cancelling group moves.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.6.0 - Steam-Cloud based map sending & misc usability improvements
notes.content:
As always, if you'd like to follow along with the development, or get some help getting started, then [url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]join us on discord! https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb[/url] 

This update brings big changes to how maps are shared, which will be a huge improvement to Game Masters with poor internet connections and provide more robust behavior overall. 

I've reworked the map distribution system to work over Steam Cloud, so that the images that are stored when you create them are shared to your players from the cloud instead of the Peer-to-Peer connection (unless something goes wrong, or you're on a LAN). 

If you've got a session coming up and want to take full advantage of this feature, you simply need to load the associated campaign to get Steam to register all the cloud images, then you can close Dudes on a Map, and they'll finish uploading and be ready for Game Day (if you don't do any of this, they'll simply get sent the old-fashioned way until Steam finishes storing them on the cloud).

0.3.6.0 Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Reworked map sending to only send maps when requested by players, rather than push-sending maps when the DM knows anyone hasn't gotten the map. (except for LAN connection, which still push the map)
[*] Implemented Steam Cloud based map-image registration, the map is then (typicallly) shared via the cloud
[*] Reworked the map-sending progress bar for the new system, this improved system should resolve some of the occassional oddities from the old progress bar.
[*] Added internal versioning of map images, allowing players to re-use cached map images in future sessions if the DM hasn't changed the image file.
[*] Added an angle adjust slider for the circle tool (when selected) making it more apparent that you can draw cones with the tool. The mouse wheel still also adjusts the angle.
[*] Replaced the Add/Select campaign buttons with a pop-up dialog that does the same thing more intuitively.
[*] Moved the Edit-Initiative menu to a pop-up dialog that isn't so easy to miss.
[*] The map list now shows status icons for the type of grid/scale each map has, as well as a status icon if it's been successfully loaded to the cloud.
[*] Players now see a message while receiving map images
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.5.2 - Small tweaks to token labels and file saving
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased the length of names displayed on tokens in a number of situations, and sets a minimum length of name that longer names can be reduced to. 
[*] Selected tokens now display their full name.
[*] Fixed a rare case where the needed directory structure was not created for token saves.
[/list]

notes.title: Discord Integration and Laser Pointers
notes.content:
As always, if you'd like to follow along with the development, or get some help getting started, then [url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]join us on discord! https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb[/url] 

This update adds the ability to send information from Dudes to your discord server. To connect the two, simply create a discord webhook in the "Edit Channel"=>Integrations menu, and copy the link to the 'Dudes on a Map' Campaign Settings tab. From there, you can decide which activities you'd like to mirror into discord, initiative, dice and even map updates can be sent.

The new laser pointer can be activated in the drawing tools menu or by simply holding the Alt key. 


Full patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added discord webhook sending for Dice rolls, which mirrors each player die-roll to the discord chat.
[*] Text to speech option allows reading of the roll summary.
[*] Added discord webhook sending for Initiative order, this will show all player-visible initiative entries, and updates each round if order changes (or you enable the 'send every round' option).
[*] Added discord webhook sending for Map Updates. Each time you do a map update, a screenshot will be taken of the map control, as it gets displayed to players, and pushed to discord.
[*] Added a manual screenshot button to capture a screenshot of the map as players would see it, and put it on the clipboard.

[*] Added a grid-square/hex painting tool for filling whole grid-cells with a few clicks.
[*] Added laser pointer tool, which shares a trail of cursor movement while the alt key is held, or while holding left-mouse with the laser tool selected.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.4.3 Minor drawing fixes and improvements
notes.content:
This patch just fixes a few issues that mostly affect the GM regarding drawing and Steam integration.
As always, if you'd like to follow along with the development then [url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]join us on discord! https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb[/url] 

[list]
[*] Zooming in and out no longer cancels active drawing/token-move operations. 
[*] Fixed Right-Clicking on map causing the map to quit updating until a left click or escape-key occurred. This was due to the recently added context menus for token links, these would intercept all events even when the menu didn't get opened on a right click.
[*] Fixed Steam lockups/crashes for GM clients with lots of workshop subscriptions.
[*] Reduced CPU/GPU utilization when no steam overlay is open by limiting fast-full-screen-refreshes to only while overlay is open or fading in/out.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.4.0 Saved Dice-Rolls system.
notes.content:
Here are the details for release 0.3.4.0. I'm pretty excited for the new features on offer here, it should really streamline play for those who like to use digital dice, without spoiling the low-friction setup for tokens.

I've also made some improvements to the Players' Game Lobby to accommodate the added information on Player Tokens, and fixed a number of bugs, including a Steam error that was causing high-CPU usage in steam itself during games.

As always, if you'd like to follow along with the development then [url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]join us on discord! https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb[/url] 

The new saved roll system works as follows:
[list]
[*] Added a small character selection panel above the standard dice tray, which hides if there's only one choice, and automatically switches selection when initiative changes.
[*] Added a button panel showing all of the selected characters rolls below the dice tray. Clicking a button once copies the saved roll into the tray, clicking again rolls it. Buttons can be right clicked to edit/delete the roll.
[*] Players can now click the edit button in the lobby to change details about their character, this includes the new saved roll editor where you can add any number of rolls.
[*] Added a saved roll editor to the DM's Token Editor tab, pre-defined tokens can have rolls saved and made better use of space on this screen in general.
[*] Added a "save roll" button on the dice history list during play. This allows you to save rolls you previously make during play and assign them to one of your tokens.
[*] Added a number of icons to identify saved rolls by.
[*] Saved rolls can use '&' to denote multiple separate rolls, these rolls are clearly separated when loaded into the dice tray (appearing the same way as the "then" button will show).
[/list]



Additional minor features and bug fixes in this release:
[list]
[*] Reduced the player drawing overlay to just a top-bar. 
[*] Greatly reduced the busyness of the Game Lobby for players.
[*] Added drawing tools, a collapsable dice tray, and initiative tracker panels to the fullscreen display.
[*] Set a fixed width for roll history entries, this should resolve weird scaling issues for high-dpi screens
[*] Fixed a fault in Steam API interactions that would infinitely retry when in a failing state, causing excessive CPU use by Steam.
[*] Fixed a crash when players press Ctrl-C with a token selected on the map.
[*] Added logic to create .bak files for tokens, and load those backups quietly in the event of corruption of the main file.
[*] Fixed an oversight that prevented the GM from rolling nothing for an opposed roll (in opposed roll mode)
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow character with / in their name to save. All symbols should now be valid in character names.
[/list]

***Hotfix 0.3.4.1: This patch shifts the preference for new installs to store data in AppData instead of Documents, newer versions of Windows tendency to store Documents on OneDrive by default causes errors for frequent accessors and doesn't work well with built-in backup files Dudes now generates. Existing installs that store on OneDrive will receive frequent nagging to migrate now, and faults provide instructions for manual resolution of the migration issues.
This patch should also reduce the annoyance level when save/load errors occur.


The new Lobby look:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/98b37b177aec0aa7fa787da5e0e289ff81aab47f.png[/img]

The full player token editor:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/1235a2f4b57ef21afea41bef7566c787d40803a9.png[/img]

A full view of the token drawer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/ea1eb8f4b8a94862550c9a8bca8ecd7577d31596.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.3.3.1 Hotfix for "Delete token" bug and improvements to Fullscreen-Mode
notes.content:
0.3.3.1 is now released
* Fixed a bug where you'd be asked if you really wanted to delete your token after every keystroke within the token editor.
* Added overlay style controls to Fullscreen mode that lets you roll dice, place tokens, do initiative, and draw while still fullscreen.
* Fixed a rare crash with the new right click menu not initializing correctly
* Tried to add a message if you run out of system memory, might not appear.

notes.title: Token Quick-Links and Bug Fixes in v0.3.3.0
notes.content:
Dudes on a Map lets you take your Pen & Paper game online with minimal effort. You can join our little community here on [url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]Discord[/url]

Version 0.3.3.0 has the following changes:
* Added links to tokens, accessible by right clicking them on the map. Players can add a private (by default) character sheet and a public art link, DM tokens can have the same, as well as additional custom links.
* Fixed most issues with Steam Overlay in Fullscreen mode on player window. Removed some faulty attempts at making this work which caused excessive CPU/GPU usage. The issue was simply a bad interaction with borderless WPF windows, and simply restoring the border while the overlay is active gives good results.
* Added a Delete hotkey for removing tokens from the token editor screen
* Fixed an issue where the server may prevent the DM from reconnecting (not recognizing the old session as disconnected, and not seeing the new session is from the same user)
* Removed measured distances on maps that are set to no-scale.
* Added some smarter initialization logic to the Map Settings in "Add Map" menu. This should initialize the map with similar token size and scale settings so switching modes won't be jarring.
* Campaign Settings file will now restore from a local backup if it's corrupted.
* Added support for small tokens, "Token Size" now goes down to 0.5 scale.
* Fixed token ghosts not always appearing where they were going to be placed.
* Fixed a bug where NPC tokens were lower resolution than intended on some maps.
* Fixed a bug where you couldn't place a token after switching maps with the token on your cursor.
* Fixed an issue with player color not updating the players tokens for themself.
* Fixed an infinite feedback loop when changing token size in multiplayer.
* Fixed a crash if you started/ended campaign name with a space
* Fixed some uncommon input, steam, and multiplayer crashes.
* Fixed an issue where windows would render a non-maximized window ghost when starting up the game window as Maximized.

notes.title: Version 0.3.2.4 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Version 0.3.2.4 has just been released with a handful of small fixes:
[list]
[*] Optimized the roll history panel, it now opens instantly and starts with the scrollbar at the bottom (most recent roll).
[*] Added logic to avoid putting new installs settings on one-drive, and any existing DM datas are given an option to migrate the settings (and again each time a save-fault occurs), while player data is moved unconditionally.
[*] Fixed a few steam-integration crashes, and added logic to initialize steam if it becomes available after you've started.
[*] (Hopefully) Fixed a server bug where certain disconnect faults could result in excessive updates to the party and potentially overload the server.
[*] Fixed a rare font crash
[/list]

Since the last few updates have been without notes, here's the previous patch notes:

Previous Version 0.3.2.3:
[list]
[*] Fixed a number of edge cases when reconnecting players to an existing game, which would result in lost tokens, tokens not showing up, etc.
[*] Added some failsafe logic that updates player position and tokens when the DM updates map, and player update if their tokens are missing from DM map, ensuring better synchronization
[*] Fixed issues with failing to connect to a room causing you to get stuck in a state where you can't connect
[*] Fixed content type radio buttons not appearing for workshop submissions that don't have token images
[*] Fixed an issue where placing player tokens for the first time would appear differently between player and DM
[*] Fixed an issue where tokens saved to whiteboard maps would be forced to coordinate 0,0 if X&Y were negative.
[*] Fixed a rare crash whenever you interacted with the UI with bad data on your clipboard
[*] Fixed problems with room-code clipboard joining.
[*] Fixed an issue where newly created tokens would be duplicated the next time you load after renaming.
[*] Fixed a rare crash from Steam not being able to run its callbacks
[*] Disconnecting clients are now removed from the player list.
[*] Cleaned up fault logic in comm layer to generate fewer ignorable reports to me, and to disconnect more cleanly when an error occurs.
[*] Added some fault handling around mouse clicks to ensure a bad-state is logged and cancels ongoing operations rather than crashing.
[/list]


The previous two releases (0.3.2.1|2) addressed a problem with connecting to pub servers, and with booting a fresh copy of dudes, respectively.

notes.title: Steam Workshop and improved Metric system support
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Dudes on a Map's Workshop page is now live! If you're new to Dudes on a Map, the free bundle includes, note that everything you need to run or play a tabletop RPG is included for FREE for the duration of early access. 
You can also [url=https://discord.com/invite/2kaQdX5zAb]join us on Discord[/url] to provide feedback or see what's in the works, or just talk shop.

The Steam Workshop export system allows you to select any maps and tokens from your current campaign with a quick description and upload.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/d9502581c6496d22b66ebe68d3f8a23c3f63ccd0.png[/img]
After selections are made, you can opt to generate stand-in tokens with a click for any token-art you don't have permission to share, making it easy to share your content with ease. 


The description generator automatically highlights items you got from other workshop authors, giving them credit in your listing, allowing you to give credit for content you got from other workshop contributors. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/51c144a0b502f72bdb2bab9c8870bfee3cbc072a.png[/img]

All of this allows you to make a quality workshop submissions from your maps in just a few minutes. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/a0320125a56f8f5dcac7371837659fee2ba35a50.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/2fd5945b30bcc3d6b4bb47bfb47f64d18466e5e5.png[/img][/url]

Meanwhile, bringing content into your game is as simple as browsing the Steam workshop, subscribing, and clicking the Import button to bring content into your chosen campaign!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/f2f40d98a6b4bbbb9b2e72ea925e2397068b426e.png[/img]


Meanwhile, the new 'Preferred Units' system will ensure you can always display distances in familiar values as well as values that match your game system. No more mental math for feet-to-meters here. Best of all this sytem is enabled by default using your windows region info to select the appropriate defaults, but check the Local Settings tab in the top right to double check.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/cc1d7ed6cd7430d47d035df1edbc7ffa538e6959.png[/img]


Along with these big features, a number of minor fixes and features have been added:
[list]
[*] Added preview generation for whiteboard maps that includes all map-lines drawn
[*] Fixed a bug with large tokens where the move immediately snapped the top-right corner to the square you clicked, potentially moving several spaces.
[*] Added logic to fail-forward until the exception reporter comes online to catch issues with user preference file generation.
[*] Added logic to try an alternate campaign save location if files cannot be written to the my-documents location and there aren't any files there already.
[*] All map-previews can now update if the map changes (and whiteboards update with each save)
[*] Added map unit options of  Inch, cm, Parsec, AU (astrological unit), and Light Year, for more flexibility.
[*] Added a Join "From Clipboard" button when connecting to a room, this lets you join without revealing your IP/Room code.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.1.0 Multi-Select support and QoL features
notes.content:
Added Multiselect features, with the following functions
[list]
[*] Ctrl+Left-click a token to add or remove it from a group.
[*] Ctrl+Left-click and drag a rectangle to add most things to a group. Some tokens (like player tokens for the GM, or locked tokens) can't be added this way, but can be added when explicitly clicking the token.
[*] Ctrl + 1-9 will save a selected token or group for later. Pressing 1-9 will recall the selection group, similar to a Real-Time Strategy game. The group selection UI also has buttons to save groups with.
[*] Dragging an item in the active selection group will move all items. Maintaining their relative positions.
[*] The group selection UI allows you to add damage to all selected, remove tokens with damage over a threshold, and edit all tokens in a group.
[*] Selection groups, and group saving is available to players as well as the GM. So players can move the party as a group.
[/list]

In addition, a number of quality of life and bug fixes have been added:
[list]
[*] Fog of war on bright colored maps will now appear as a dark transparent shade for the GM
[*] Players on whiteboard maps now see fog of war as a opaque black, rather than looking like empty grid space.
[*] Added an add-damage function to selected token, and made the overall selection menu a little more compact.
[*] Added smooth-scrolling of the map while an arrow/wasd key is held. This also makes controller navigation better.
[*] Added a campaign option to always sort rolls high-to-low by default. If enabled, individual rolls can be reverted to as-rolled order by clicking the descending bars icon in the upper left of the roll result (and vice-versa to sort a roll that's not sorted)
[*] When you have multiple separate-rolls in a single batch due to split dice (like rolling 2d20 with the default config) there is now only one header displaying what was rolled.
[*] There is now an option to enable player control of GM tokens, so the GM can grant party control of NPCs as needed.
[*] Fixed an issue where erasing fog erased few extra pixels around the selection area, including 0-width erases, making it possible to leave little jagged edges in snap mode.
[*] Previous quiet release 0.3.0.3 added a function to toggle sorting on an individual die roll when clicked on. It also fixed a couple of crashes introduced in the prior release.
[/list]

Edit: Minor Patch 0.3.1.1 released,  drastically improves the responsiveness of drawing and token moves, and fixes a few bugs from the prior release with moving Player-Controlled-NPCs, and a bug with the new group-image-assignment buttons.

notes.title: 0.3.0.0 Whiteboard maps, Map Creator Overhaul, Bulk Token & Map creation
notes.content:
Beautifully drawn maps are great and all, but sometimes you just need to put up a room with some obstacles and bad guys, and that's where the whiteboard map shines. No need to provide a map image or setup anything complex, just doodle some lines and roll for initiative with these lightweight options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/6efd1772398ed0586eaff5c118e674bb6c0867f8.png[/img]

In addition, new bulk add options for tokens and maps make it easier to bring your game to life with new content, with the ability to configure grids and saved preferences for bulk and individual grids, you can bring your maps online quicker than ever.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/9cd650e3bec7b07c31ef915185dbb53013fe223a.png[/img]

Lastly, there's a new, more flexible game lobby. Players can add and drop tokens on the fly, update their image, name, and color during play. The game master can also assign images to players, and if the player doesn't already have an image, it will be saved for them for next time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39777312/e82dda193e24b5cbf3cb4e9272486fffa544d1ae.png[/img]

Here's a full list of the changes:
[list]
[*] Added whiteboards to the map creation options, these maps are infinitely scroll-able and don't have a background image, just select the color and you're ready to go.
[*] Overhauled the game lobby workflow. Players can change their token selections anytime, even during play. All options for the player can be modified in or out of a session, before or after readying.
[*] Added Ctrl-C and a copy button to clone the selected token, allowing you to quickly add more combatants to a fight.
[*] Added logic to factor-out the scaling Dudes does to your maps upon import, so if you exported from a map creation tool, the grid size you enter in Dudes will match what the tool exported. (Maps you already added to Dudes will not be affected by this change).
[*] Overhauled the map creation screen. Now, you can elect to configure your grid at map creation time, and these settings will be remembered for your next map. This is extremely helpful if you use a drawing tool with consistent scaling.
[*] Added a bulk-map option to the map creation screen, this will let you select lots of maps, and apply consistent grid settings to them all.
[*] Added button in token editor for adding any number of tokens directly from image files, using the filename for the token name.
[*] Added storage on each map for your last-view position and zoom level.
[*] Added logic to re-scale drawing and grid features when  a new image is applied to an existing map, with different dimensions.
[*] Added a home-button for whiteboard maps to take you back to the center-point of the map.
[*] Added a * to the save button to indicate when changes are present.
[*] Added save buttons to token and campaign screens, and Ctrl-S now saves as well.
[*] Fixed several bugs related to sending and caching of player tokens images and other settings.
[*] Improved the layout of the token-drawer and selected item area.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused de-selecting tokens on the map to behave oddly with various tools.
[*] Added an option to tokens to allow players to control an DM token. This will make adding friendly NPC's to an adventure a little easier.
[*] The 'Add Map' button now gently flashes when you don't have any maps yet.
[*] REALLY added logic for the gridline color to auto-select based on image/background color. This code got lost somehow in the last patch.
[/list]

Edit: Hotfix 0.3.0.1 Fixed a crash when deselecting/deleting your last map. Added configuration info for SteamInput (controller works fairly well), and updated settings for Steamplay

notes.title: 0.2.2.2 Miscelaneous Quality of Life and Networking Fixes
notes.content:
Fixes in this version are small and pretty sporadic so here's the list:

[list]
[*] Auto-detect map luminance and select white/black gridlines at map image change.
[*] Added feature to shuffle-style initiative to shuffle after a configurable number of rounds
[*] Added a notes field to tokens and token defs so you can write down anything you want about tokens
[*] Added a forced color option to token drawer tokens, so you can predefine colors of tokens instead to override the drawer color selector.
[*] Changed hit detection to use the actual image size and text size, instead of the full token size + text height. This should limit 'invisible' hitbox area if you keep token images well cropped.
[*] Fixed custom roll strings in campaign settings not populating for players the first time they roll initiative with a custom roll type.
[*] Locked tokens are now removed from initiative 
[*] Added a prompt to save before switching campaigns, very sorry if this got anyone 
[*] Allowed use of rulers while the DM has drawing disabled because they aren't publicly visible
[*] Added support for DNS connections (like my.server.com instead of 192.168.1.1)
[*] Added super experimental, and probably broken IPv6 support, if you're tech savvy and have an IPv6 address please let me know how well this works for you!! (note: once connected, you shouldn't see any differences in stability)
[*] Fixed dice symbols not getting sent with dice when you use the public server
[*] Removed the original public server, now down to a single server again, this will cut costs down to a sustainable level based on sales. Usage doesn't seem to warrant the extra server, it is currently unusual to see more than one session on either server, so this shouldn't affect anyone too much, but let me know if you see reduced performance.
[/list]

Beyond this version, life is starting to free up more development time, so I'm hopeful to see a bit more frequent and impactful updates in the coming weeks. For the next update I'm planning to improve the process for adding faster methods of adding multiple maps and tokens from images.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2.0 - Awesome Gaming Table features, Quality of Life & Bug Squashing
notes.content:
To follow along with the development, report a problem, or just say 'hi', [url=https://discord.com/invite/2kaQdX5zAb]Join us in Discord![/url]

This patch has a lot of cool stuff in it for everyone, but if you're on a gaming table it's especially noteworthy. A lot of these changes came by request from users, and it's a lot of good stuff!

[list]
[*] Fixed the steam overlay, it now works just like you'd expect in a game.
[*] Added a fullscreen option to the player client, in the top right near the local settings button. This will hide the UI and the map will use the entire screen.
[*] Added Physical sizing options for the player client, in the Local Settings tab, where you can enter your screen size and resolution and how many inches or millimeters you want each grid-square to be, the map will zoom to give you squares of that size (with options to zoom in and out a little bit 2x, 1/2x, and 1/4x).
[*] Added a lights out button for the game master, which blanks all player screens until the next update view. I added this as a way to reduce player distractions during narrative segments.
[*] Added a toggle switch that lets the GM disable player drawing and dice (separately), because sometimes people can't behave.
[*] Added a campaign option to prevent players from moving other players tokens.
[*] Added logic to save the location of player tokens between sessions. These locations are saved with the map, so each map you've had players on will remember where they were (if the player is in the game at the start of the next game)
[*] Added some guidlines for token images to the token manager screen.
[*] Added an option to lock a token in place so it can't be moved until unlocking.
[*] Added support so that custom images assigned to tokens on the map are now being saved between sessions. I mistakenly said this worked in the tutorial video, so now I've made it work that way.
[*] Added confirmation dialogs before kicking and banning players.
[*] Added options so you can choose when you see movement trace and distance overlay (never, always, or during initiative). The new default is always show the movement path, but only show distance during initiative.
[*] The game tab is now hidden when you don't have a game started.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused grid-measure tool to be broadcast to others.
[*] Fixed a bug that spammed my error reporting service if you set NaN or huge values for grid scale.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing your campaign settings while you had opposed rolls to make in the client would crash the program.
[*] Fixed a rare crash when moving tokens.
[*] Removed the little red X at the bottom middle of the screen.
[/list]

As ever, please get in touch if you encounter problems, have cool ideas, or anything else really.

notes.title: 0.1.7.1 Patch Notes - Small bug fixes
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]Join us on discord[/url] to join the beta or follow along with development!


[list]
[*] Fixed Player map jerking around each initiative turn (and probably many other times)
[*] Fixed a bug where you initial initiative sorts would be wrong (I think)
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't select the roll button if the previous initiative ended on your turn.
[*] Fixed a bug where unloading maps and deleting tokens weren't getting saved (so they would return when you restart)
[*] Change tool priorities so you can  no longer grab tokens while using ruler tools or the circle tool (instead you use the tool when clicking, since these often center on your/a character)
[*] Fixed ALWAYS being asked to save changes when you exit, there may be some things falsely flagging changes, but the biggest offender has been resolved.

notes.title: 0.1.7.0 Patch Notes - Initiative options & Fixes, 64bit support & general polish
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/2kaQdX5zAb]Join us on discord[/url] to join the beta or follow along with development!


[list]
[*] Added options to support action-cost systems (multiple turns/round), exploding dice, custom-player roll entry (e.g. 3d6!)
[*] Added an option to automatically update players when the DM stops drawing.
[*] Fixed a number of initiative bugs that have been observed by simplifying the network layer.
[*] Initiative system now lets players who join mid-combat also join the fun.
[*] Overlay text and lines now scale as you zoom in and out, making it easier to see/read drawing and token move details.
[*] Added support for 64-bit mode, this allows for larger maps to be used reliably, reduces the down-scaling required to load them.
[*] Added color circles to the UI where tokens don't have an assigned image, instead of having a blank space.
[*] Large tokens now present better in the various grid types, a circle-token fills the appropriate hexes/squares to the edges.
[*] Added gutters around the outside of the map when you zoom out or pan around, giving a little more freedom of movement for panning the map.
[*] Undo's for token moves are now assigned to the undo stack of the player that owns the token, rather than the person who moved it.
[*] Drawing a shape/line and then erasing the same will no longer leave residual color behind (this was due to anti-aliasing, so there are some visible jaggies on drawn shapes now)
[*] Fixed an uncommon player disconnect when moving tokens.
[*] Fixed a crash when backing up to the beginning while using the grid wizard.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.6.0 Patch Notes - Undo/Redo, Mouse-Click/Scaling Bug Fix, Tool-Tip hiding
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now undo/redo drawing and token movement with buttons in the toolbar, or ctrl-z, ctrl-y (as is tradition). DM undo of changes to the map are sent using the update, just like fog changes.

[*] The big tool help text can be hidden via a 'corner-X', this hide is per-map since usually map shape determines how annoying it is. The Local settings tab in the top right has the option to disable tips entirely.

[*] Fixed a bug, where screen DPI scaling was not properly accounted for, and caused map to draw smaller than usual within map panel, and ALL mouse clicks on the map would be inaccurate. Only occurred in certain OS/monitor configurations, but made Dudes barely usable.

[*] When the DM moves a player token, the move-preview is now broadcast to players. NPCs movements are (still) private, and players only see the token pop into the new location.

[*] Re-Added logic to prevent anyone from grabbing a token that someone else is moving.
[/list]


Updated later in the evening with the same software version, but now the binaries are all signed.

notes.title: 0.1.5.3 Patch Notes - Themes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] UI Theme can be changed in the settings tab in the top-right corner in both clients. Red is still default, but added Yellow, Blue, Orange, Purple, Green, and Pink. I plan to research additional options for colorblindness support on the main map-renderer to help resolve potential issues there as well.
[*] Fixed an exception caused by loading an image from (older?) saves also attempting to save it 
[*] Fixed a crash due to corrupted image files
[*] Improved the behavior for snap on all tools, now the draw-preview shows where it will end up according to the snap point
[*] Improved erase functionality for rectangle/circle tools, this will now erase as wide as it draws (and not leave behind outlines half of the drawn line)
[/list]

If anyone is still seeing crashes or severe errors after this patch when loading/switching maps, please do get in touch on the forums/discord/kickstarter.

notes.title: 0.1.5.1 & 0.1.5.2 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
- Added a grid alignment tool which allows you to match the size of a printed grid or scale on your map.
- Switched from having all maps auto-loaded to only loading the selected map, saving memory and allowing bigger maps
- Split up the map data, image and preview into separate files so they don't have to stay in memory.
- Increased map image area from 4 million pixels to 12 million.
- Increased heartbeat timeout on the public server, so even slow internet can take advantage of the new big maps.

Hotfix:
- Added a message when an access denied error prevents directory or map file creation, asking for help in tracking this issue down as it's a permissions issue I need more info about.
- Fixed an issue where players weren't able to return to previously visited maps.

notes.title: Grids and Improved Drawing Tools are Live!
notes.content:
The new drawing tools are live and ready to use, this massive update really brings a lot of useful kit to the table:
[list]
[*]Grids and snapping mean you can keep tokens neat and tidy
[*] Measurement tools make it easy to plan out moves
[*] New overlay markers make it easy to highlight places on the map or discuss tactics
[*] A variety of shape tools to better fit those non-rectangular rooms!
[*] Map Layer markers so the GM can mark changes in the environment
[/list]

This is a huge overhaul, so be sure to give me a shout if you encounter any problems, or things that don't make a lot of sense.


I've done some house keeping on the [url=https://trello.com/b/FKm3XXrg/dudes-on-a-map-planned-features-ideas]Trello Board[/url] so you can check out the plan going forward, for now I'm working on some wrapping up of the new tools as well as tracking down some bugs in the initiative system, but within a month I hope to be kicking off the Dice Tray systems.
